title: Design System: SPOT Global Spatial Design Intelligence

shadows.name: glow-hover
shadows.purpose: Warm accent glow on hover state

motion.name: ease-slide
motion.purpose: Slide up transition for cards and modals

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action button with neon orange background.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #f97316; color: #ffffff; padding: 10px 20px; font-weight: 600; border: none; border-radius: 12px; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #ea580c; }

components.name: Spot Card
components.description: Dark zinc surface card for spatial spot records.
components.css: .ds-card-spot { background: #18181b; border: 1px solid rgba(39, 39, 42, 0.8); border-radius: 16px; padding: 16px; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; color: #f4f4f5; transition: border-color 0.3s; } .ds-card-spot:hover { border-color: rgba(249, 115, 22, 0.6); } .ds-card-badge { display: inline-block; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 8px; background: rgba(18, 18, 20, 0.85); border: 1px solid rgba(154, 52, 18, 0.6); font-family: monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; color: #fdba74; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; }

narrative.overview: SPOT is a high-contrast dark field intelligence platform designed for spatial design researchers, visual merchandisers, and store planners.
keyCharacteristics: Dual typography pairing sans-serif with monospace telemetry labels

rules.name: The Telemetry Rarity Rule
rules.body: Neon orange (#f97316) is used on <=10% of any screen.

rules.name: The Telemetry Label Rule
rules.body: Data attributes are strictly formatted in monospace font.

dos: Do use #f97316 (Neon Orange) for active states and key metrics.
Do format technical metadata in uppercase monospace typography.
donts: Don't use bright high-saturation background colors.
Don't overuse neon orange on body text.
